interface.longDescription: Codex-compatible packaging for ClawCode. The MCP memory, identity, reminder registry, Codex service runner, voice, WebChat, doctor, and skill surfaces can run under Codex. Claude Code channel plugins and Claude launch flags are reported as Claude-only instead of being advertised as Codex features.
